green-snake.maybe_skip_if: you want straightforward mythology or grounded realism
green-snake.summary: A review calls it "a mischievous, sensual riff on the Legend of the White Snake," and that is a very good entry point. It is lush, strange, and all about color, movement, and mood.

guardians-of-the-galaxy-vol-3.good_pick_if: you want a blockbuster that remembers to have a heart
guardians-of-the-galaxy-vol-3.maybe_skip_if: you are fully burned out on Marvel no matter what
guardians-of-the-galaxy-vol-3.summary: Calling it an "apology letter from marvel studios" is a funny way to say it has more feeling and personality than people expected. It is loud and goofy, but it actually lets the hurt matter.

guillermo-del-toros-pinocchio.good_pick_if: you want a visually rich family-friendly fantasy with real feeling behind it
guillermo-del-toros-pinocchio.maybe_skip_if: you want a lighter or less emotionally weighted take on Pinocchio
guillermo-del-toros-pinocchio.summary: People call it "one of the year's most expressive and imaginative films," and that fits its haunted, handmade warmth.

hachi-a-dogs-tale.good_pick_if: you want a big sobber with a sincere heart
hachi-a-dogs-tale.maybe_skip_if: you are actively avoiding movies built to make you cry
hachi-a-dogs-tale.summary: The blunt pitch is that if you don't love that dog by the end, "your soul is dead," and the movie absolutely lives in that pure loyalty-and-tears lane.

hair-raising-hare.good_pick_if: you want a short classic that fires on every comic cylinder
hair-raising-hare.maybe_skip_if: you need a bigger story than pure gag engineering
hair-raising-hare.summary: The best review note is that there are "a million little touches" elevating it. That is exactly why it lands: the gags are sharp, the animation is elastic, and even tiny expressions feel perfectly timed.

hamnet.good_pick_if: You want a sweeping drama that leans fully into ache, love, and loss.
hamnet.maybe_skip_if: You want distance, irony, or a lighter historical watch.
hamnet.summary: A good one-line sell is that it is "emotionally devastating but ultimately cathartic." It plays as prestige drama with real feeling instead of museum stiffness, which makes it a strong pick if the room wants something romantic, mournful, and openly emotional.

hannah-and-her-sisters.good_pick_if: you want a talky relationship movie that still feels generous
hannah-and-her-sisters.maybe_skip_if: you want the family drama played with more bitterness
hannah-and-her-sisters.summary: That "I'd like to be bothered" line is the sweet spot for the movie. It is full of adult mess, but what makes people love it is the warmth, the seasonal texture, and how genuinely it cares about family friction.

happiness.good_pick_if: You want something fearless, nasty, and likely to provoke nervous laughter all night.
happiness.maybe_skip_if: You want emotional safety or are not up for deeply disturbing subject matter.
happiness.summary: People describe it as "bleak and uncomfortable" and still somehow hysterical, which is the only honest warning label. It is a brutally funny cringe-machine that keeps daring the room to laugh at the worst possible moment.

harakiri.good_pick_if: You want something serious and gripping that turns honor, class, and pride into real dramatic tension.
harakiri.maybe_skip_if: You want light vibes, a fast pace, or a more straightforward action-first samurai movie.
harakiri.summary: People call it "the honourable code is weaponised by those in power," and you can feel that tone from the first minutes. It is tense, elegant, and quietly furious, with striking black-and-white framing and a story that keeps deepening without showing off.

hard-boiled.good_pick_if: You want nonstop momentum, huge stunts, and a pure adrenaline watch.
hard-boiled.maybe_skip_if: You want quiet scenes, gentle pacing, or a softer tone.
hard-boiled.summary: People call it "Maybe the perfect action movie," and that is the whole sales pitch. It is furious, inventive, and built for anyone who wants the kind of action where momentum alone feels thrilling.

harold-and-maude.good_pick_if: you want a strange, sweet romance that keeps getting warmer
harold-and-maude.maybe_skip_if: you want a more conventional love story
harold-and-maude.summary: People describe Harold and Maude as "two pieces of the same puzzle," and that captures the movie's sweet spot: oddball romance, deadpan humor, and a surprisingly life-affirming glow.

heat-1995.good_pick_if: you want a serious, stylish crime movie that feels huge without being messy
heat-1995.maybe_skip_if: you want something light, fast, or less macho
heat-1995.summary: People call it "cool in the best way," and that really is the sell: immaculate heist-movie tension with grown-up swagger and room-filling intensity.

her.good_pick_if: you want something tender, thoughtful, and a little wistful
her.maybe_skip_if: tech-romance as a premise just does not work for you
her.summary: The best sincere review take is that it feels like a "big warm blanket" when you are down. The movie is melancholy and futuristic, but its real appeal is how gently it handles loneliness and longing.

hereditary.good_pick_if: You want a horror movie that feels upsetting before it even gets supernatural.
hereditary.maybe_skip_if: You need relief, safety, or anything easy to shake off afterward.
hereditary.summary: People describe it as "pure psychological dread and drama," which is why it works so well beyond jump-scare expectations. It is suffocating, funny in a very dark way, and full of family tension sharp enough to unsettle a whole room.

hero-2002.good_pick_if: you want martial-arts spectacle that feels graceful, not just loud
hero-2002.maybe_skip_if: you want a rougher or more grounded action movie
hero-2002.summary: The phrase "action as emotionality" is exactly why this lands. Every fight feels like feeling made physical, and the color-driven visual design gives the whole movie a mythic, painterly calm.

high-and-low.good_pick_if: you want a sharp, grown-up thriller that stays tense without feeling frantic
high-and-low.maybe_skip_if: you want something breezier or less dialogue-driven
high-and-low.summary: People call it "an astonishingly detailed crime epic," but it plays more like a locked-in pressure machine. It is tense, precise, and great for a room that likes watching smart people sweat through impossible choices.

high-noon.good_pick_if: You want a lean Western that feels like a countdown with a human face.
high-noon.maybe_skip_if: You want sprawling action, modern pacing, or a more forgiving crowd pleaser.
high-noon.summary: A classic pressure cooker where the whole town becomes "ticking time bomb tension" by the minute.

his-girl-friday.good_pick_if: you want old Hollywood comedy with nonstop momentum
his-girl-friday.maybe_skip_if: machine-gun dialogue feels more stressful than fun
his-girl-friday.summary: Calling it a "screaming match of a film" is basically the pitch. The fun is the impossible speed, the flirt-fight chemistry, and the feeling that every scene is trying to outtalk the last one.

hit-the-road-2021.good_pick_if: You want a warm, funny drama that can pivot into something deeper without forcing it.
hit-the-road-2021.maybe_skip_if: You want broad comedy only or a road movie without any sadness in it.
hit-the-road-2021.summary: People call it "a beautiful road trip film with a whole load of heart," which is the right invitation for something this funny and tender. The family-chaos energy keeps it lively, but the emotional undercurrent is what makes it stick after the credits.

holiday.good_pick_if: You want an old-Hollywood romance that feels breezy without being empty-headed.
holiday.maybe_skip_if: You want wilder farce or less social critique under the comedy.
holiday.summary: The cleanest pitch is that it is an "anti-capitalist screwball classic," because the movie is both airy and quietly rebellious. Grant and Hepburn keep it buoyant, but the real pleasure is how firmly it sides with a freer, less money-poisoned idea of a good life.

hope-2013.good_pick_if: you want an earnest, deeply emotional drama about healing after something terrible
hope-2013.maybe_skip_if: you want a lighter night or do not want to sit with heavy trauma material
hope-2013.summary: People call it a "painful and heartbreaking experience," and the movie earns that by staying close to family aftermath instead of sensationalizing the damage.

hot-fuzz.good_pick_if: you want a fast comedy with clean setup, big payoffs, and constant momentum
hot-fuzz.maybe_skip_if: you want subtle humor or a movie that never fully commits to the bit
hot-fuzz.summary: People keep saying it is "everything an Edgar Wright movie should be," and that is exactly the point: joke density, pacing, and small-town mayhem all click.

house.good_pick_if: You want horror that behaves like a fever dream and still feels playful.
house.maybe_skip_if: You want coherent logic, clean suspense, or a movie that stays in one tone.
house.summary: The hook is that it is a "weirdly comforting nightmare," which is exactly the balance Obayashi strikes. It is chaotic, colorful, and so unhinged that it loops back around to being fun.

how-the-grinch-stole-christmas.good_pick_if: you want a Christmas watch that stays funny on repeat
how-the-grinch-stole-christmas.maybe_skip_if: you want a longer special or something less aggressively festive
how-the-grinch-stole-christmas.summary: The enduring appeal is that it is "the best grinch movie period," a short, sharp holiday classic that gets the joke, the heart, and the rhythm exactly right.

how-to-train-your-dragon.good_pick_if: You want an uplifting adventure that works for kids and adults.
how-to-train-your-dragon.maybe_skip_if: You want something edgy, grim, or less openly sentimental.
how-to-train-your-dragon.summary: The easy hook is "beautiful, funny, nostalgic," and that is still the best summary of its appeal. It is big-hearted, funny, and emotionally smooth in a way that makes it easy to recommend to almost anyone.

hunt-for-the-wilderpeople.good_pick_if: you want a crowd-friendly comedy with real heart

i-saw-the-devil.good_pick_if: you want an extreme thriller with real velocity and menace

i-vitelloni.good_pick_if: You want a patient coming-of-age hangout film that gradually hardens into something sadder.

i-was-born-but.good_pick_if: You want quiet, patient comedy-drama with a real emotional aftertaste.

ikiru.good_pick_if: You want something reflective, moving, and a little soul-resetting.

il-sorpasso.good_pick_if: you want a stylish hangout movie with movement, charm, and a little bittersweet edge

im-still-here-2024.good_pick_if: You want a grounded drama with real weight and a human center.

in-a-lonely-place.good_pick_if: You want a romantic thriller with great lines and a tense mood.

in-bruges.good_pick_if: You want sharp dialogue, grim humor, and a surprisingly tender center.

in-cold-blood.good_pick_if: You want a serious, atmospheric crime watch that stays controlled and haunting.
in-cold-blood.maybe_skip_if: You want comfort, levity, or anything remotely breezy.
in-cold-blood.summary: People keep pointing to "the shadows from the rain," which is a good sign this plays like a cold, meticulous crime drama with real visual force.

in-the-mood-for-love.good_pick_if: You want a beautifully made romance that lives in mood and glances.
in-the-mood-for-love.maybe_skip_if: You want open emotional displays or a plot that moves fast.
in-the-mood-for-love.summary: The appeal is right there in "beautiful color combinations": this is a movie of looks, pauses, and atmosphere. It is tender, restrained, and devastatingly stylish without ever feeling busy.

in-the-name-of-the-father-1993.good_pick_if: You want a serious drama that hits hard and gives the room something to rally around.

in-this-corner-of-the-world.good_pick_if: You want a thoughtful war-era drama that values lived-in detail over spectacle.
in-this-corner-of-the-world.maybe_skip_if: You want a fast-moving wartime story or something emotionally light.

incendies.good_pick_if: You want something gripping, emotionally heavy, and built to leave the room quiet after.
incendies.maybe_skip_if: You want comfort, gentleness, or spoilers about why this one is so upsetting.

inception.good_pick_if: You want a blockbuster that feels smart, polished, and easy to get swept up in.

indiana-jones-and-the-last-crusade.good_pick_if: you want a crowd-friendly adventure with warmth and momentum

infernal-affairs.good_pick_if: you want a sharp, efficient crime thriller
infernal-affairs.maybe_skip_if: you want something more relaxed or character-loose
infernal-affairs.summary: People call it "all killer tension," and that is the movie's best argument: undercover-thriller momentum, clean emotional stakes, and almost zero wasted motion.

inglourious-basterds.good_pick_if: You like big personalities, long suspense scenes, and stylized violence.
inglourious-basterds.maybe_skip_if: You want historical seriousness over pulp energy.
inglourious-basterds.summary: People call it "a masterclass in tone control," and that really is the fun of it. It is talky, funny, tense, and swaggering enough that even the long scenes feel like set pieces.

interstella-5555-the-5tory-of-the-5ecret.good_pick_if: you want a relaxed, music-driven watch with strong visual mood

interstellar.good_pick_if: you want big-screen sci-fi that still hits emotionally
interstellar.maybe_skip_if: you prefer tighter, simpler stories without a lot of scale or feeling
interstellar.summary: People latch onto the "heart attack of feelings" part as much as the scale, because it plays like giant sci-fi with a very human center.

invasion-of-the-body-snatchers-1978.good_pick_if: you want a tense, unsettling sci-fi horror that keeps tightening the screws
invasion-of-the-body-snatchers-1978.maybe_skip_if: you want easy laughs or a low-stress watch

investigation-of-a-citizen-above-suspici.good_pick_if: You want a sharp satire that keeps its cool while it gets stranger.
investigation-of-a-citizen-above-suspici.maybe_skip_if: You want a straightforward police procedural or comfort watch.
investigation-of-a-citizen-above-suspici.summary: People keep circling "cinema of the absurd" because this turns a police-power joke into a sharp, eerie power game. It is dry, sly, and much funnier than its premise sounds.

isle-of-dogs-2018.good_pick_if: you want something charming, handcrafted, and easy to settle into
isle-of-dogs-2018.maybe_skip_if: you want looser energy or less stylization
isle-of-dogs-2018.summary: People call it "meticulous and adorable," and that is more or less the appeal: deadpan Wes Anderson design wrapped around a surprisingly sincere rescue-mission heart.

it-happened-one-night.good_pick_if: You want a classic rom-com that moves fast and wins on chemistry.
it-happened-one-night.maybe_skip_if: You want something moodier or less built around playful bickering.

its-a-wonderful-life.good_pick_if: you want something warm, reassuring, and easy for a room to get behind
its-a-wonderful-life.maybe_skip_if: you want something cooler, sharper, or less openly sentimental
its-a-wonderful-life.summary: People call it "the movie that makes you feel seen" and "earnest in a way that still works." It is sentimental, yes, but in a full-hearted way that plays beautifully with a group.

its-such-a-beautiful-day.good_pick_if: you want artful animation at a short but high-impact length
its-such-a-beautiful-day.maybe_skip_if: you want something lighter or less existential tonight
its-such-a-beautiful-day.summary: People call it "a painterly short with surprising heart," and it earns that by being funny, melancholy, and quietly huge all at once.

james-acaster-cold-lasagne-hate-myself-1.good_pick_if: you want comedic storytelling with social discomfort turned funny
james-acaster-cold-lasagne-hate-myself-1.summary: People love that "self-loathing is a joke, not a wall," so it stays candid and messy without turning into a downer.

jfk.good_pick_if: you want a big, propulsive political rabbit hole
jfk.maybe_skip_if: you want calm restraint or a neutral viewpoint

joe-pera-talks-you-to-sleep.good_pick_if: you want a very low-key laugh and something genuinely calming
joe-pera-talks-you-to-sleep.maybe_skip_if: you want a big, high-energy comedy instead of a whisper-level one
joe-pera-talks-you-to-sleep.summary: People call it "ridiculously soothing" and "the funniest possible lullaby." It is tiny, deadpan, and weirdly caring, like a reset button for a room that wants to exhale instead of rev up.

john-mulaney-new-in-town.good_pick_if: you want a light, funny group watch with immediate laughs
john-mulaney-new-in-town.maybe_skip_if: you want something looser or more confrontational
john-mulaney-new-in-town.summary: People say it is "ridiculously quotable," and that is really the whole case. It has that polished early-special snap where every story sounds tossed off even though the timing is absurdly tight.

john-wick-chapter-4.good_pick_if: You want maximal action craft and do not mind a movie flexing for three hours.
john-wick-chapter-4.maybe_skip_if: You want emotional subtlety or action with less ritualized brutality.
john-wick-chapter-4.summary: The room-level pitch is simple: it is action as "operatic violence" stretched to absurdly satisfying scale. Even at its length, it keeps finding new ways to turn choreography, color, and geography into applause moments.

joint-security-area.good_pick_if: You want a gripping drama that is tense, moving, and very easy to talk about after.
joint-security-area.maybe_skip_if: You want something lighter or less politically charged.
joint-security-area.summary: People call it a "beautiful canvas of tragedy and comedy," which gets at why it sticks. It starts like a mystery, then opens into something much sadder and more human about friendship across a line that should not exist.

jojo-rabbit.good_pick_if: you want something funny, tender, and a little risky in tone
jojo-rabbit.maybe_skip_if: you want historical material handled without tonal swings
jojo-rabbit.summary: People keep calling it an "emotionally layered satire," which is why it lands for groups: funny enough to keep moving, but never so glib that it loses the ache underneath.

judgment-at-nuremberg.good_pick_if: You want a serious courtroom drama with real moral weight.

jujutsu-kaisen-0.good_pick_if: you want flashy battles with emotion pushed all the way up

jurassic-park.good_pick_if: You want a blockbuster that still feels precise and rewatchable.

kikis-delivery-service.good_pick_if: You want something soothing, kind, and easy to settle into.
kikis-delivery-service.maybe_skip_if: You want conflict, intensity, or a plot with bigger spikes.

kill-bill-the-whole-bloody-affair.good_pick_if: you want loud, stylish action with big attitude

kill-bill-vol-1.good_pick_if: You want something loud, fun, and incredibly sure of its own cool.
kill-bill-vol-1.maybe_skip_if: You want emotional subtlety or have low tolerance for graphic violence.

kill-bill-vol-2.good_pick_if: you want the more character-focused half of a big revenge story
kill-bill-vol-2.maybe_skip_if: you want nonstop velocity instead of a steadier finish
kill-bill-vol-2.summary: People still frame it as "my baby Beatrix" territory, which fits a chapter that slows down just enough to make the payback feel more personal.

kiss-me-deadly.good_pick_if: You want a genre movie that keeps widening its scope and getting stranger.
kiss-me-deadly.maybe_skip_if: You want a clean detective story with a neat, reassuring answer.

kizumonogatari-part-2-nekketsu.good_pick_if: you want anime action that is flashy, strange, and fully committed

kizumonogatari-part-3-reiketsu.good_pick_if: you want something slick, heightened, and unapologetically anime

klaus.good_pick_if: You want a festive pick that is genuinely charming instead of just noisy.
klaus.maybe_skip_if: You want something less seasonal or less openly heartfelt.

kneecap.good_pick_if: you want something loud, funny, and very alive

knives-out-2019.good_pick_if: You want a smart, funny whodunit that plays great with a group.
knives-out-2019.maybe_skip_if: You want something darker, moodier, or less openly playful.
knives-out-2019.summary: People still call it a "highly entertaining crowd pleaser," and that remains the right baseline. The mystery machinery is tight, the ensemble is ridiculously fun to watch, and the whole thing has enough bite to keep a mixed group engaged.

kubo-and-the-two-strings.good_pick_if: you want family fantasy that looks gorgeous and means it
kubo-and-the-two-strings.maybe_skip_if: you want something looser or less emotionally earnest
kubo-and-the-two-strings.summary: The phrase "staggeringly beautiful and immensely true" gets why this lingers. It is a handmade fantasy adventure with real visual grace, but it also knows how to turn storytelling and memory into emotional stakes.

kung-fu-hustle.good_pick_if: you want a martial-arts comedy with nonstop visual invention and big crowd energy
kung-fu-hustle.maybe_skip_if: you want your action movies played straight or your comedy a little drier
kung-fu-hustle.summary: People call it "gloriously silly but always smart about its silliness," which is basically the whole deal. It is fast, inventive, and happy to keep escalating the gag count without losing the action.

kung-fu-panda.good_pick_if: you want a family action movie that actually earns its feelings
kung-fu-panda.maybe_skip_if: you want something weirder than polished studio animation

kuroneko.good_pick_if: you want a serious, eerie classic that leans on mood and image
kuroneko.maybe_skip_if: you want a tidy plot or a gentler horror watch
kuroneko.summary: People keep returning to the "haunting visuals" because this ghost story feels elegant, cruel, and quietly mournful from the first frame.

kwaidan.good_pick_if: You want elegant horror that feels like folklore, not jump-scare machinery.
kwaidan.maybe_skip_if: You want something brisk, modern, or bluntly terrifying.

la-belle-noiseuse.good_pick_if: you want a dense art film that rewards patience and close attention
la-belle-noiseuse.maybe_skip_if: you want something concise or plot-first
la-belle-noiseuse.summary: People say it reaches "hypnotization," which is the right word for a long, slow burn about art, looking, and control.

la-confidential.good_pick_if: you want a polished, adult thriller with big rewatch value

la-dolce-vita.good_pick_if: you want something stylish, talky, and built around mood

la-haine.good_pick_if: You want something raw, kinetic, and socially charged without feeling preachy.

la-la-land.good_pick_if: you want a dreamy musical with strong visual polish

lady-vengeance.good_pick_if: you want a polished revenge thriller with bite and visual confidence

lady-vengeance.summary: People keep pointing to the "intoxicating editing" because the movie is as much icy control and style as it is revenge payoff.

larry-david-curb-your-enthusiasm.good_pick_if: you want dry embarrassment comedy and already like Larry David's whole deal

last-life-in-the-universe.good_pick_if: you want something reflective and emotionally soft-spoken
last-life-in-the-universe.maybe_skip_if: you need lots of dialogue or a brisk plot
last-life-in-the-universe.summary: People describe it as "a supremely beautiful tale of gentle love," but it stays tender, hypnotic, and strangely comforting.

latalante.good_pick_if: You want a poetic black-and-white romance with atmosphere to spare.
latalante.maybe_skip_if: You want a plot-heavy watch or something less dreamy and patient.
latalante.summary: People return to it because the "inventive camerawork and perfectly-paced montage" imply feelings that dialogue cannot replace. It is romantic without being sugary, and the setting gives every small gesture a little extra glow.

le-samourai.good_pick_if: You want an elegant, minimalist thriller with heavy style and little wasted motion.
le-samourai.maybe_skip_if: You want warmth, chatter, or a more conventional crime plot.
le-samourai.summary: The cleanest pitch is "Suffering in style," and that really is the vibe. It is cool, spare, and exquisitely composed, built for anyone who likes their crime movies icy, elegant, and self-contained.

leave-her-to-heaven.good_pick_if: You want melodrama that plays like a gorgeous, slow-tightening psychological thriller.
leave-her-to-heaven.maybe_skip_if: You want sympathetic romance or something less venomously intense.

leon-the-professional.good_pick_if: you want a sharp action thriller with real momentum and strong character work
leon-the-professional.maybe_skip_if: you want something soft, subtle, or less morally messy
leon-the-professional.summary: People still call it "downright gripping, thoroughly entertaining & wholly satisfying," and that remains the cleanest pitch. It is sleek, tense, and powered by performances that keep the whole thing moving.

let-the-right-one-in.good_pick_if: you want something eerie, intimate, and unexpectedly gentle

life-of-brian.good_pick_if: You want a quotable comedy that hits fast, keeps swinging, and actually has a brain.
life-of-brian.maybe_skip_if: You want gentler humor or do not want the room to get irreverent.

lilo-stitch.good_pick_if: You want something funny, tender, and a little unruly.
lilo-stitch.maybe_skip_if: You want a tidy plot or a perfectly behaved Disney movie.
lilo-stitch.summary: People still quote "this is my family ... still good," which is basically the whole appeal: messy family feeling, goofy alien energy, and real sweetness.

little-amelie-or-the-character-of-rain.good_pick_if: You want a tender animated film that feels hand-made and attentive.
little-amelie-or-the-character-of-rain.maybe_skip_if: You want fast pacing or big spectacle.
little-amelie-or-the-character-of-rain.summary: People call it "a breath of fresh air," and that fits a gentle, painterly coming-of-age story that stays curious, tactile, and emotionally close to the ground.

little-miss-sunshine.good_pick_if: You want something funny, human, and easy to get a whole group on board with.
little-miss-sunshine.maybe_skip_if: You want bigger style swings or a movie with less bittersweet family tension.

logan-2017.good_pick_if: You want comic-book material with real melancholy and weight.
logan-2017.maybe_skip_if: You want bright, quippy, or plot-light superhero energy.
logan-2017.summary: "SO THIS IS WHAT IT FEELS LIKE" is a fair reaction, because the movie plays like a bruised farewell more than a standard superhero ride. It is rugged, intimate, and unusually willing to sit in exhaustion and care.

long-haired-hare.good_pick_if: You want a short, sharp Looney Tunes gem with immaculate timing.
long-haired-hare.maybe_skip_if: You want something long-form or not built around rapid-fire cartoon logic.
long-haired-hare.summary: People still call it "my favorite Bugs Bunny short" because it is that exact kind of perfect cartoon: precise, musical, rude, and funny enough to feel eternal.

lost-highway.good_pick_if: you want something eerie, stylish, and deliberately disorienting
lost-highway.maybe_skip_if: you want answers, closure, or a stable reality
lost-highway.summary: People call it "nightmare logic cinema," and that is the right invitation: pure dread, sensual weirdness, and a movie that feels dangerous even when it is standing still.

love-and-anarchy.good_pick_if: you want something messy, funny, and charged with feeling
love-and-anarchy.maybe_skip_if: you want politics handled in a cooler or more sober register
love-and-anarchy.summary: The line "feelings are a luxury and this is war" gets at the push-pull here: political urgency, romantic confusion, and a movie that somehow stays rowdy, sad, and alive all at once.

love-exposure.good_pick_if: you want a fearless film with a long attention reward
love-exposure.summary: People call it "wildly alive," and that is really the sell for a movie this huge, strange, and emotionally all-in.

love-streams.good_pick_if: You want something unruly, intimate, and more felt than neatly explained.
love-streams.maybe_skip_if: You want tidy structure or controlled performances over emotional sprawl.
love-streams.summary: The cleanest invitation is that it lives between "idk what's going on" and "wow that hits." It is messy, funny, tender, and emotionally raw in a way that feels less polished than most dramas and more alive because of it.

loving-vincent.good_pick_if: you want something visually special and emotionally gentle
loving-vincent.maybe_skip_if: you want less stylization or more narrative urgency
loving-vincent.summary: People call it "a moving painting," and that is basically the appeal. The handmade look is the headline, but the melancholy mood is what keeps it from feeling like a gimmick.

m.good_pick_if: You want an old thriller that still feels urgent, creepy, and formally inventive.
m.maybe_skip_if: You want something lighter or less psychologically heavy tonight.
m.summary: The appeal is how "far ahead of its time" it still feels. It is a crime movie, but also a sharp social nightmare, with tension and moral unease that make it feel startlingly modern.

macross-do-you-remember-love.good_pick_if: you want maximal anime energy with romance and warfare both turned up
macross-do-you-remember-love.maybe_skip_if: you want a low-key story or are allergic to melodrama
macross-do-you-remember-love.summary: The shorthand is "silly and spectacular and sugary," which fits: this is mecha melodrama with huge scale, huge feelings, and a very committed pop-opera pulse.

mad-max-2.good_pick_if: You want stripped-down action storytelling that feels primal and iconic.
mad-max-2.maybe_skip_if: You want psychological depth over speed, motion, and survival drive.
mad-max-2.summary: A lot of people respond to how Max becomes "less a character than a mythic figure," and that is the right way in. It is pure chase-movie propulsion, full of battered metal, desert heat, and one of the cleanest action premises ever built.

mad-max-fury-road.good_pick_if: You want a loud, fast, nearly wordless action movie with zero dead time.
mad-max-fury-road.maybe_skip_if: You want dialogue-heavy drama or a calmer pace.
mad-max-fury-road.summary: The appeal is right there in "action tells the story more than dialogue." It is propulsive, immediate, and almost absurdly efficient, which makes it a great pick for anyone who wants spectacle to do the heavy lifting.

magnolia.good_pick_if: you want a sprawling drama that goes all the way big
magnolia.maybe_skip_if: you want subtlety, restraint, or emotional distance
magnolia.summary: Calling it the "quickest 3 hours ever" makes sense once it gets moving. It is an emotional avalanche: huge performances, overlapping ache, and maximalist filmmaking that somehow keeps the whole mess alive.

make-way-for-tomorrow.good_pick_if: you want a classic that earns tears honestly
make-way-for-tomorrow.summary: "Aging is devastating" is blunt, but accurate. The movie hurts because it is so gentle and observant about everyday indignity, and because its sadness comes from ordinary family failure rather than melodramatic tricks.

malcolm-x-1992.good_pick_if: you want a sprawling drama with intelligence and fire
malcolm-x-1992.maybe_skip_if: you want something shorter or less intense
malcolm-x-1992.summary: People call it "electrifying biography," and that is the right angle: huge performance energy, political force, and a real sense of historical scale.

marcel-the-shell-with-shoes-on-2021.good_pick_if: you want something gentle, funny, and more emotional than it first lets on
marcel-the-shell-with-shoes-on-2021.maybe_skip_if: you want a louder comedy or something less openly tender
marcel-the-shell-with-shoes-on-2021.summary: People call it "tiny and devastating" and "the sweetest movie about being lonely." It is funny in a very soft-spoken way, then quietly becomes one of those picks that has a whole room feeling a lot.

marty-supreme.good_pick_if: you want a big-swing drama with real swagger
marty-supreme.maybe_skip_if: you want restraint or something less keyed up
marty-supreme.summary: People call it "maximalist in a really fun way," and the appeal is that it plays like ambition turning feral: flashy, intense, and never remotely modest.

mary-and-max.good_pick_if: you want something intimate, funny-sad, and a little emotionally scruffy
mary-and-max.maybe_skip_if: you want a lighter animated watch without loneliness in the mix
mary-and-max.summary: People call this "sad, funny, and deeply human" and "a friendship movie with real bruises." It is odd-looking, very sweet, and sharper emotionally than its handmade style might make you expect.

mary-poppins.good_pick_if: you want an old-school family musical with real charm
mary-poppins.maybe_skip_if: you want less cheer and less stagey fantasy
mary-poppins.summary: The joke that "mary poppins will overthrow capitalism" works because the movie has that impossible mix of sternness, whimsy, and social sweetness. It feels practical and magical at the same time.

mei-and-the-kittenbus.good_pick_if: you want a brief, low-stress Ghibli hit
mei-and-the-kittenbus.maybe_skip_if: you need a feature-length story or bigger stakes
mei-and-the-kittenbus.summary: People call it "the most adorable short ever," and that is the whole pitch: tiny, cozy, and basically designed to make a room go soft.

memento.good_pick_if: You want a thriller built around confusion, repetition, and payoff.
memento.maybe_skip_if: You want an easy-to-follow story or a low-effort rewatch.
memento.summary: People love the feeling of "not knowing what is going on," which is basically the point. It is a puzzle-box thriller that stays tense because it never lets you settle into certainty.

memories.good_pick_if: you want a multi-flavored animated sci-fi watch with real craft and no wasted runtime
memories.maybe_skip_if: you want a single, linear story with one consistent tone
memories.summary: People like that it gives you "three different science fiction animated stories," which means three distinct moods without wasting the anthology format.

memories-of-murder.good_pick_if: You want a crime movie that is more haunting than flashy.
memories-of-murder.maybe_skip_if: You want clean catharsis, quick pacing, or a lighter room vibe.
memories-of-murder.summary: People call it "dark, patient, and absolutely unforgettable," which gets at the mood fast. It is funny, sad, and deeply uneasy in a way that keeps the tension hanging over everything.

metalocalypse-the-doomstar-requiem-a-klo.good_pick_if: you want big songs, absurd jokes, and a finale that still has heart
metalocalypse-the-doomstar-requiem-a-klo.maybe_skip_if: you want anything subtle or not remotely metal
metalocalypse-the-doomstar-requiem-a-klo.summary: People call it an "emotional support rock opera" for a reason: it is loud, funny, and weirdly sincere about the band underneath the jokes.

metropolis.good_pick_if: You want a foundational classic that still feels bold and visually overwhelming.
metropolis.maybe_skip_if: You want something subtle, intimate, or less openly monumental.
metropolis.summary: People call it "a dream alive on the screen," which gets at why it still works. It is gigantic, stylish, and weirdly alive, the kind of silent sci-fi landmark that can still make a room go wow.

millennium-actress.good_pick_if: You want something imaginative, romantic, and a little dreamy without becoming vague.
millennium-actress.maybe_skip_if: You want a straighter plot or less time-bending storytelling.
millennium-actress.summary: The appeal is that it feels like a "beautiful and surreal love letter" to movies, memory, and longing all at once. It is playful, wistful, and constantly shifting without losing its emotional center.

millers-crossing.good_pick_if: you want a crime movie with language, atmosphere, and tragic swagger
millers-crossing.maybe_skip_if: you want cleaner plotting than Coen knotwork
millers-crossing.summary: The line "There’s nothing more foolish than a man chasing his hat" feels like the whole movie in miniature: elegant, funny, fatalistic, and weirdly romantic about people destroying themselves over pride and loyalty.

mind-game.good_pick_if: You want something maximal, strange, and genuinely unlike almost any other animated feature.
mind-game.maybe_skip_if: You want tonal stability, neat storytelling, or a more family-friendly anime pick.
mind-game.summary: If "a deep, meditative reflection of life" inside total sensory chaos sounds good, this is your movie. It is messy on purpose, wildly inventive, and best for a group that wants animation to feel like a dare.

mirror.good_pick_if: you want something lyrical, open-ended, and visually hypnotic
mirror.maybe_skip_if: you want a clear plot or easy orientation
mirror.summary: People call it "pure memory logic," and that is the key to enjoying it: less a story you track than a flow of images, feeling, and drifting recollection.

misery.good_pick_if: You want a tense, one-room thriller that stays nasty, efficient, and easy to feel in a group.
misery.maybe_skip_if: You want something breezier or less locked into captivity and pain.
misery.summary: A tight, nasty pressure cooker that still feels like a "slightly better caretaker than Annie Wilkes" joke, which is another way of saying it is pure suspense.

mishima-a-life-in-four-chapters.good_pick_if: You want something visually adventurous that still gives the room a lot to chew on.
mishima-a-life-in-four-chapters.maybe_skip_if: You want a simpler character study or less formally ornate filmmaking.
mishima-a-life-in-four-chapters.summary: The big draw is how "boldly stylised" it is without losing the human pull. It turns biography into something operatic, intellectual, and visually rich enough that the whole movie feels like staged obsession.

missing.good_pick_if: You want a serious thriller that gets its force from truth, fear, and anger.
missing.maybe_skip_if: You want escapism or something less tied to state violence.
missing.summary: One reviewer quotes it as "they are killing people here, and nobody knows who's next," which tells you how urgent it feels. It is a political thriller powered less by gimmicks than by dread, outrage, and the slow collapse of official lies.

mobile-suit-gundam-chars-counterattack.good_pick_if: You want anime spectacle with real feeling and a lot of ideological friction.
mobile-suit-gundam-chars-counterattack.maybe_skip_if: You want casual onboarding or a standalone watch with no lore gravity.
mobile-suit-gundam-chars-counterattack.summary: One great review says it is "impossibly sad," which gets past the giant-robot surface fast. The movie is big, political, and emotionally charged in a way that makes the spectacle feel tragic rather than merely cool.

modern-times.good_pick_if: you want a classic that is funny, tender, and easy to watch with other people
modern-times.maybe_skip_if: you need dialogue-heavy comedy or something less old-Hollywood
modern-times.summary: One reviewer called it "laugh out loud funny," which is still the easiest sell. It has Chaplin's precision, but it also feels loose, sweet, and surprisingly easy for a room to fall into.

mommy-2014.good_pick_if: you want a full-volume drama that really goes for it
mommy-2014.maybe_skip_if: you want emotional distance or a calmer watch
mommy-2014.summary: People call it "emotionally enormous," and that fits: raw performances, huge feelings, and filmmaking that makes intimacy hit like a physical force.

mon-oncle.good_pick_if: you want a gentle comedy built from design, rhythm, and observation
mon-oncle.maybe_skip_if: you want punchlines, speed, or a louder style of funny
mon-oncle.summary: One reviewer says "being modern is almost a slur," which is exactly the joke here: a precise, playful comedy where every gadget and layout choice becomes a sight gag.

monsieur-verdoux.good_pick_if: You want Chaplin doing something sly, acid, and unusually cynical.
monsieur-verdoux.maybe_skip_if: You want pure slapstick or a comedy that stays comfortably innocent.
monsieur-verdoux.summary: The hook is how Chaplin turns it into "a cinema of kindness and gentleness" while keeping the whole thing darkly funny and razor-edged. It is elegant, cynical, and much sharper about greed than its polite surface suggests.

monster-2023.good_pick_if: you want something moving, thoughtful, and a little quietly devastating
monster-2023.maybe_skip_if: you want a cleaner thriller engine or less emotional ambiguity
monster-2023.summary: People call it "gentle and heartbreaking" and "so human," which is a good read on why it connects. It starts from tension, then keeps nudging the room into a more emotional and compassionate place, so it is a strong pick if you want something thoughtful that still gives everyone a lot to talk about.

monsters-inc.good_pick_if: You want a funny, easy crowd-pleaser with heart.
monsters-inc.maybe_skip_if: You want a darker or more sarcastic animated comedy.
monsters-inc.summary: People still talk about how it is "absolutely immaculate vibes," and that pretty much captures the cheerful chemistry, workplace comedy, and warm payoff.

monty-python-and-the-holy-grail.good_pick_if: You want pure silliness, quick laughs, and a very quotable watch.
monty-python-and-the-holy-grail.maybe_skip_if: You need polished pacing or comedy that stays grounded.
monty-python-and-the-holy-grail.summary: Calling it a "horse owner on a coconut budget" is exactly the right kind of nonsense. It is aggressively silly, endlessly quotable, and basically built for a room that wants to laugh at how far a joke can be stretched.

moonlight-2016.good_pick_if: you want a beautifully made drama that feels intimate, humane, and emotionally exact
moonlight-2016.maybe_skip_if: you want something broad, loud, or emotionally distant
moonlight-2016.summary: People call it "the most tender, empathetic film to touch my soul," and that emotional precision is the whole point.

moonrise-kingdom.good_pick_if: you want something sweet, stylized, and gently off-center
moonrise-kingdom.maybe_skip_if: you want realism or less deliberate design
moonrise-kingdom.summary: People call it "entirely charming," and that is really the whole sell: storybook framing, runaway-kid sincerity, and a melancholy that never dulls the whimsy.

mr-smith-goes-to-washington.good_pick_if: You want a classic with heart, momentum, and old-school optimism.
mr-smith-goes-to-washington.maybe_skip_if: You want cynicism, sharp cynic energy, or modern political realism.
mr-smith-goes-to-washington.summary: Calling it "undeniably delightful" is not subtle, but it is accurate. It is earnest, brisk, and built around the pleasure of watching one decent person collide with a machine that badly needs shaking up.

mulan.good_pick_if: You want a spirited underdog story with action and heart.
mulan.maybe_skip_if: You want a slower, less eventful, or more adult drama.
mulan.summary: The strongest sell is that "all she wanted was to prove herself," which is exactly the kind of drive the movie rewards. It is spirited, funny, and built around a lead who makes the whole adventure feel earned.

mulholland-drive.good_pick_if: You want a late-night head trip with atmosphere to spare.
mulholland-drive.maybe_skip_if: You want literal answers or a mystery that plays fair in a conventional way.
mulholland-drive.summary: People call it "mesmerising throughout," which is about as clean a pitch as this movie allows. It is dreamy, seductive, and unsettling in a way that makes confusion part of the fun rather than a bug.

my-neighbor-totoro.good_pick_if: You want something calm, healing, and lovely enough to reset the room.
my-neighbor-totoro.maybe_skip_if: You need a stronger plot engine or more overt conflict.
my-neighbor-totoro.summary: People call it a "warm blanket for the soul," which is about as perfect a pitch as this movie gets. It is gentle, magical, and completely unhurried, built around the feeling of safety, wonder, and small joys.

my-winnipeg.good_pick_if: You want something eccentric, essayistic, and strangely emotional beneath the oddness.
my-winnipeg.maybe_skip_if: You want realism or a documentary that sorts fact from fantasy for you.
my-winnipeg.summary: One review calls it "the best written voice over I can remember having heard," and that is a great way into Guy Maddin's dream-logic hometown myth. It is funny, haunted, and so specific that the city starts feeling like a memory you had yourself.

mysterious-skin.good_pick_if: you want a deeply affecting drama that treats pain and memory with real seriousness
mysterious-skin.maybe_skip_if: you want lighter themes or an easy emotional recovery afterward
mysterious-skin.summary: People say it is "a film that leaves scars," and that is the cleanest way to describe how tender, brutal, and haunting it is.

mystery-train.good_pick_if: You want a relaxed ensemble movie with great atmosphere and very dry humor.
mystery-train.maybe_skip_if: You want higher stakes or a story that pushes harder than it wanders.
mystery-train.summary: A good pitch is that you can "just vibe out" with it, because the movie runs on mood, deadpan timing, and late-night Memphis drift more than plot mechanics. It is easygoing, funny, and cool in a way that never needs to announce itself.

naked.good_pick_if: you want something abrasive, brilliant, and impossible to love cleanly
naked.maybe_skip_if: you need even a little decency from the lead
naked.summary: The funniest short pitch is "joker for british guys," but the real pull is darker: a vicious, talky, night-wandering character study that is somehow magnetic even when it is being horrible.

napoleon.good_pick_if: you want a classic that feels huge, playful, and formally alive
napoleon.maybe_skip_if: you want historical drama in a compact package
napoleon.summary: The joke about getting picked on and deciding to "become the Emperor of France" fits because this is an insanely ambitious silent epic that treats history like a playground for formal invention and giant feeling.

nashville.good_pick_if: You want a big ensemble movie where the connections are the point.
nashville.maybe_skip_if: You want a tight story with one clear lead or a fast payoff.
nashville.summary: People keep circling back to "everything is connected," and that is the movie's whole superpower. It is sprawling, playful, and full of overlapping lives, so the appeal is as much about the social web as any single plotline.

nausicaa-of-the-valley-of-the-wind.good_pick_if: You want a fantasy adventure with scope, urgency, and one of animation's great heroes.
nausicaa-of-the-valley-of-the-wind.maybe_skip_if: You want something cozier and less war-shaped in its stakes.
nausicaa-of-the-valley-of-the-wind.summary: People call it an "astounding and spectacular" animated film, and it earns that. It has adventure energy, giant imagination, and a real moral pulse, which makes it feel both sweeping and deeply sincere.

negative-space.good_pick_if: you want a quick, elegant short that lands harder than its runtime suggests
negative-space.maybe_skip_if: you want something expansive or plot-heavy
negative-space.summary: People call it a "beautiful portrayal of a complicated father-son relationship," which is impressive for something this brief and spare.

neon-genesis-evangelion-the-end-of-evang.good_pick_if: you like emotionally intense, symbolic movies that really go for it
neon-genesis-evangelion-the-end-of-evang.maybe_skip_if: you want a clean, easy-to-follow ending or a chill watch
neon-genesis-evangelion-the-end-of-evang.summary: The big appeal is that it "punches you in the face" emotionally, turning anxiety, identity, and scale into one overwhelming anime experience.

network.good_pick_if: you want a sharp, talky movie that still feels uncomfortably current
network.maybe_skip_if: you want something relaxed or less verbally aggressive
network.summary: People still call it "hauntingly prophetic" because it plays like both satire and warning at the same time.

night-of-the-living-dead.good_pick_if: you want the template-setter that still feels raw and immediate
night-of-the-living-dead.maybe_skip_if: you need glossy effects or a modern pace
night-of-the-living-dead.summary: People still call it "Undeniably important horror history," and that is the sell: stark, tense, and brutally influential.

night-on-earth.good_pick_if: You want a conversational, low-stakes ensemble watch that drifts instead of rushes.
night-on-earth.maybe_skip_if: You want one big plot or a film that builds toward a single payoff.
night-on-earth.summary: People keep it on the shelf for being "one of the most nocturnal films of all time," and that is the right kind of invitation. It is loose, funny, and quietly observant, like eavesdropping on five different late-night moods.

nightcrawler.good_pick_if: you want a tense crime thriller that feels cold and predatory
nightcrawler.maybe_skip_if: you want something comforting or morally soothing
nightcrawler.summary: People keep calling it "a master of making me feel uneasy" because the whole movie runs on sleek menace, moral rot, and constant pressure.

nights-of-cabiria.good_pick_if: You want something tender and emotional that still leaves the room with a lift.
nights-of-cabiria.maybe_skip_if: You want a gentler ride or less repeated emotional punishment along the way.
nights-of-cabiria.summary: People love that it is ultimately "bleak yet hopeful," which is exactly the balance that makes it connect. It is funny, bruised, and deeply affectionate toward someone who keeps choosing openness in a world that does not reward it.

nimona-2023.good_pick_if: you want something funny, fast, and openly on the side of weird kids
nimona-2023.maybe_skip_if: you want fantasy adventure without identity politics in the mix
nimona-2023.summary: The "be gay, (reluctantly) do crime" mood is basically the clean pitch. It is rambunctious, funny, and emotionally direct in a way that makes the outsider anger feel heartfelt instead of packaged.

nirvanna-the-band-the-show-the-movie.good_pick_if: you want music-adjacent comedy with a playful, fan-friendly flow
nirvanna-the-band-the-show-the-movie.maybe_skip_if: you want a tightly plotted narrative film
nirvanna-the-band-the-show-the-movie.summary: People just call it "a certified banger," which fits the movie's chaotic, homemade, bit-first hangout energy.

no-country-for-old-men.good_pick_if: you want a lean, ruthless thriller with deadpan humor and real pressure
no-country-for-old-men.maybe_skip_if: you want a warmer ride or more obvious catharsis
no-country-for-old-men.summary: People call it "bone-dry and terrifying" and "cool in a scary way," which is exactly the vibe. It is stripped back, funny in a very dark register, and so confident in its pacing that the tension feels almost casual until it suddenly is not.

no-other-choice-2025.good_pick_if: you want a sharp thriller with black-comic cruelty
no-other-choice-2025.maybe_skip_if: you want something gentle or morally reassuring
no-other-choice-2025.summary: People call it "mean in a thrilling way," and the pull is that it turns humiliation, desperation, and dark comedy into something nervy and uncomfortably alive.

nobody-knows.good_pick_if: You want a serious, deeply humane drama that builds emotion through patience.
nobody-knows.maybe_skip_if: You need a lighter watch or want to avoid child-abandonment material tonight.
nobody-knows.summary: The appeal is how it stays "heartbreaking and powerful" without ever bullying you into tears. It is gentle, observant, and devastating in a way that feels earned because the movie pays such close attention to ordinary moments.

north-by-northwest.good_pick_if: You want an all-time crowd-pleaser with pace and style.
north-by-northwest.maybe_skip_if: You want something slow, dark, or psychologically heavy.
north-by-northwest.summary: People love how it is "a situation" for Cary Grant, because the movie never stops moving once the chase starts. It is sleek, witty, and built for pure suspense with just enough romance and comedy to keep it light on its feet.

nostalgia-1983.good_pick_if: you want something meditative and emotionally dense
nostalgia-1983.maybe_skip_if: you want momentum or a cleaner narrative engine
nostalgia-1983.summary: People call it "overwhelming and blinding on first watch," which fits a movie built on longing, memory, and spiritual drift more than plot momentum.

notorious.good_pick_if: you want old-Hollywood suspense with real romantic charge
notorious.maybe_skip_if: you want something rougher or less polished
notorious.summary: People call it "romantic espionage perfection," and that feels earned. It is all chemistry, suspense, and elegant Hitchcock craftsmanship.

nowhere.good_pick_if: you want something messy, loud, and genuinely one of a kind
nowhere.maybe_skip_if: you want narrative stability or tonal control
nowhere.summary: "Kafka’s metamorphosis but bisexual" is a funny but useful pitch. The movie plays like a neon panic attack full of horny confusion, apocalypse vibes, and queer chaos that somehow never stops being alive.

oceans-eleven-2001.good_pick_if: You want something slick, easy, and extremely reliable with a group.
oceans-eleven-2001.maybe_skip_if: You want grit, danger, or a heist movie that feels heavier than fun.
oceans-eleven-2001.summary: The simplest pitch is that it is "smart, stylish & sophisticated" without ever getting smug. It moves like pure movie-star confidence, all chemistry, rhythm, and easygoing charm.

oldboy.good_pick_if: You want something intense, stylish, and absolutely not polite.
oldboy.maybe_skip_if: You are sensitive to graphic violence or punishing emotional material.
oldboy.summary: People call it "emotionally ruthless," which is about as fair a heads-up as you can give. It is nasty, stylish, and so committed to its own extreme energy that the room usually locks in fast.

om-shanti-om.good_pick_if: you want something huge, emotional, and joyfully extra
om-shanti-om.maybe_skip_if: you want tonal restraint or a short runtime
om-shanti-om.summary: The review yelling about a "6 minute song" to the murderer gets why this rules. It is maximal, melodramatic, and totally committed to giving heartbreak, glamour, and movie-mad feeling the biggest possible stage.

once-upon-a-time-in-america.good_pick_if: you want a gangster epic that feels bruised rather than triumphant
once-upon-a-time-in-america.maybe_skip_if: you want cleaner pacing or less heaviness
once-upon-a-time-in-america.summary: That "not good fellas" joke is one way into a movie that plays less like a swagger piece and more like a haunted memory. It is sprawling, melancholy, and heavy with regret the whole way through.

once-upon-a-time-in-the-west.good_pick_if: You want a western that feels monumental, stylish, and completely assured.
once-upon-a-time-in-the-west.maybe_skip_if: You need quicker pacing or a less reverent, more playful genre ride.
once-upon-a-time-in-the-west.summary: People call it a "jaw-dropping work of blazing originality," and the movie backs that up with pure cinematic confidence. It is slow on purpose, huge in feeling, and powered by faces, music, and atmosphere more than chatter.

one-battle-after-another.good_pick_if: You want a movie that keeps its rhythm and has a strong musical pulse.
one-battle-after-another.maybe_skip_if: You want something quieter, looser, or less driven by tempo.
one-battle-after-another.summary: People like that it has "good pacing, great score," which is exactly the kind of praise that tells you the movie will carry a group. It is energetic, music-forward, and should work well if you want something that keeps moving and keeps sounding good while it does.

one-cut-of-the-dead.good_pick_if: you want a funny, inventive group watch and can trust the setup
one-cut-of-the-dead.maybe_skip_if: you want instant polish or zero patience upfront
one-cut-of-the-dead.summary: People call it "joyfully scrappy," and that is the best non-spoilery pitch. It starts rough on purpose, then turns into one of the most generous crowd-pleasers around.

one-flew-over-the-cuckoos-nest.good_pick_if: You want a classic that mixes humor, menace, and rebellion in one package.
one-flew-over-the-cuckoos-nest.maybe_skip_if: You want something gentle or less pointed about power and control.
one-flew-over-the-cuckoos-nest.summary: People call it "always relevant" because the conflict still lands cleanly. It is a fierce, funny, and increasingly upsetting institutional drama with a huge rebellious streak.

one-way-or-another.good_pick_if: You want a brainy, oppressive thriller that feels like a bad meeting turning into a fever dream.
one-way-or-another.maybe_skip_if: You want something light, linear, or low on ideological bite.
one-way-or-another.summary: It plays like a "claustrophobic nightmare" about corrupt power, so the appeal is pressure, satire, and political rot.

onibaba.good_pick_if: you want horror that feels raw, strange, and physical
onibaba.maybe_skip_if: you want clean modern scares or emotional safety
onibaba.summary: People describe it as "sweaty swamp terror," and that is the right warning. It is primal, sexy, unnerving horror that feels sticky and inescapable.

only-yesterday.good_pick_if: you want something gentle, thoughtful, and deeply human
only-yesterday.maybe_skip_if: you need stronger plot engines than memory and mood
only-yesterday.summary: The note that its flashback structure feels "seamless and true to life" is exactly why it lingers. The movie understands how memory works: small, random, and suddenly overwhelming in retrospect.

open-your-eyes.good_pick_if: You want a stylish mind-bender that keeps shifting genres under your feet.
open-your-eyes.maybe_skip_if: You want airtight explanation or less dream-logic confusion.
open-your-eyes.summary: The best spoiler-safe setup is that it is "a film for people who like mysteries more than they like answers." It is sexy, disorienting, and committed to making reality feel unstable in a way that can be very fun with the right room.

opening-night.good_pick_if: you want actorly chaos with real emotional risk
opening-night.maybe_skip_if: you want restraint or a smoother tone
opening-night.summary: People describe it as "acting on a live wire," and that is the main reason to watch: Gena Rowlands going huge, messy, funny, and terrifyingly open.

ordet.good_pick_if: You want a serious, patient drama that builds feeling without showy tricks.
ordet.maybe_skip_if: You want brisk pacing or a movie that explains itself loudly.
ordet.summary: People keep calling it "very well executed," and the appeal is how calmly it turns faith, grief, and conviction into a slow-burn pressure cooker.

out-of-the-past.good_pick_if: you want classic noir with style and clean momentum
out-of-the-past.maybe_skip_if: you want moral clarity or modern pacing
out-of-the-past.summary: People call it "noir as hell," and that covers the appeal nicely: fatalistic romance, razor-sharp atmosphere, and dialogue that lands like a cigarette snap.

paddington-2.good_pick_if: You want a movie that is funny, sweet, and reliably restorative.
paddington-2.maybe_skip_if: You want cynicism, edge, or a movie that fights back harder.
paddington-2.summary: The best shorthand is that it can "reset the mind and heart," and that is not an exaggeration. It is warm, nimble, and disarmingly kind, with enough comic precision to feel fresh even on repeat viewing.

paper-moon.good_pick_if: you want a smaller cast with strong chemistry and wit
paper-moon.maybe_skip_if: you prefer overt, punchy comedy first
paper-moon.summary: People call it "warm" and "witty," and the fun is how much personality it gets out of scrappy little exchanges and lived-in chemistry.

paprika-2006.good_pick_if: You want an animated thriller that feels unstable in the best possible way.
paprika-2006.maybe_skip_if: You want a straightforward plot or a movie that stays neatly explained.
paprika-2006.summary: People call it a "fever dream," and that is the right expectation: slippery, vivid, and full of dream-logic momentum that keeps turning the room in new directions.

parasite-2019.good_pick_if: you want tension that keeps changing shape while staying funny
parasite-2019.maybe_skip_if: you dislike ambiguity and moral discomfort
parasite-2019.summary: People say it has you "laughing at one moment & then questioning that laughter the next," which is a pretty great pitch for how funny and tense it gets at the same time.

paris-texas.good_pick_if: You want a beautiful, sad movie that earns its emotions slowly.
paris-texas.maybe_skip_if: You want a plot-heavy watch or something emotionally lighter.
paris-texas.summary: A review saying it "left me in shambles" is not exaggerating much. This is a spare, aching road movie about distance, memory, and the hope of finding a way back to people.

pastoral-to-die-in-the-country.good_pick_if: you want a bold art-film trip that treats memory like a living stage set
pastoral-to-die-in-the-country.maybe_skip_if: you want linear storytelling or a movie that explains itself politely
pastoral-to-die-in-the-country.summary: People describe it as "fragmented and prismatic," and that fits a surreal memory piece that keeps childhood, theater, and fantasy in uneasy motion.

paths-of-glory.good_pick_if: You want a tight classic that turns moral anger into real momentum.
paths-of-glory.maybe_skip_if: You want something softer, less bitter, or more expansive in scale.
paths-of-glory.summary: People call it "furious and exact," and that is about right. It is lean, unsentimental, and angry in a way that still plays like a knockout tonight.

patlabor-2-the-movie.good_pick_if: You want a stylish animated thriller with real intelligence behind it.
patlabor-2-the-movie.maybe_skip_if: You want something light, goofy, or simpler in its setup.
patlabor-2-the-movie.summary: Calling it "the coolest thing I've ever seen" makes sense once the movie starts flexing its control and atmosphere. It is smart, polished, and exactly the kind of animated sci-fi pick that can win over people who want style with substance.

peeping-tom.good_pick_if: you want old-school horror with craft and real creep factor
peeping-tom.maybe_skip_if: you want slashier thrills than slow-burn discomfort
peeping-tom.summary: The "I bet Hitchcock wished he made this" reaction makes sense. It is elegant, nasty, and weirdly self-aware, with a voyeuristic chill that feels both classic and ahead of its time.

perfect-blue.good_pick_if: You want a stylish head-trip that stays tense the whole way through.
perfect-blue.maybe_skip_if: You want a straightforward plot or less disturbing material.
perfect-blue.summary: People call it "emotionally destabilizing," and that is pretty much the pitch. It is sleek, disorienting, and the kind of psychological thriller that makes every scene feel a little less stable than the last.

perfect-days-2023.good_pick_if: you want something peaceful, reflective, and surprisingly nourishing
perfect-days-2023.maybe_skip_if: you want stronger conflict or faster pacing
perfect-days-2023.summary: People call it "a gentle reset," and that is the mood: a movie about routine, texture, and tiny pleasures that somehow leaves the room feeling fuller.

persepolis.good_pick_if: You want something smart, personal, and historically grounded without feeling stiff.
persepolis.maybe_skip_if: You want escapism or a story with less political pain in it.
persepolis.summary: The big draw is its "earnest depiction" of growing up under pressure without losing wit or personality. It is sharp, funny, politically alive, and personal enough that it never plays like homework.

persona.good_pick_if: You want something unsettling and formally daring that gives people a lot to chew on.
persona.maybe_skip_if: You want clear answers or a more literal kind of psychological drama.
persona.summary: A classic pitch is that you come back for the "beauty of its images" even when the mysteries stay slippery. It is intense, elegant, and best for a room that likes psychological movies to feel like an encounter instead of a puzzle to solve cleanly.

phantom-of-the-paradise.good_pick_if: You want a bizarre music-movie cult piece with big personality.
phantom-of-the-paradise.maybe_skip_if: You want a straightforward genre movie or a normal emotional tone.
phantom-of-the-paradise.summary: The phrase "visiting an old friend" fits because this one plays like a beloved cult oddity people are happy to revisit. It is campy, theatrical, and musically charged, with a gleefully strange energy that keeps it from feeling ordinary for a second.

pirates-of-the-caribbean-the-curse-of-th.good_pick_if: you want adventure, jokes, and big crowd-friendly momentum
pirates-of-the-caribbean-the-curse-of-th.maybe_skip_if: you want something understated or less openly crowd-pleasing
pirates-of-the-caribbean-the-curse-of-th.summary: One review nails it as "blockbuster heaven," and the movie does feel that easy to click with. It is breezy, funny, and just polished enough to keep the whole room locked in.

platoon.good_pick_if: you want a war movie that feels raw and spiritually scorched
platoon.maybe_skip_if: you want a less brutal or less chaotic battle portrait
platoon.summary: The best short review note here is that Willem Dafoe was "being robbed of awards." The movie lands because the performances make the jungle feel morally split, sweaty, and violently immediate instead of abstract.

playtime.good_pick_if: You want something patient, playful, and packed with background jokes for the whole room to notice.
playtime.maybe_skip_if: You need a stronger plot engine or comedy that announces every punchline.
playtime.summary: People call it "absurd, gorgeous," and that is the entry point. It is less about plot than about wandering through a giant visual joke machine and catching more details the longer you sit with it.

police-story.good_pick_if: you want action that is funny, inventive, and crowd-ready
police-story.maybe_skip_if: you want realism or less slapstick energy
police-story.summary: People call it "stunt-comedy perfection," and that feels hard to top. It is Jackie Chan chaos at full speed, with real danger and even better comic timing.

ponyo.good_pick_if: You want something gentle, whimsical, and visually overflowing with charm.
ponyo.maybe_skip_if: You want a tightly plotted fantasy or a movie that stays grounded.
ponyo.summary: People call it "cutie and sweet," which is the cleanest way to explain how it works: pure color, motion, and childlike wonder with just enough chaos to keep it lively.

poor-things-2023.good_pick_if: you want a weird, vivid, and very alive art-film crowd-pleaser
poor-things-2023.summary: People love that it is "wildly absurd" while staying warm and sweet, which is a good shorthand for how big, strange, and open-hearted it gets.

porco-rosso.good_pick_if: you want animation that feels light on its feet but emotionally rich
porco-rosso.maybe_skip_if: you want higher stakes or less nostalgic softness
porco-rosso.summary: People call it "cool, wistful, and goofy," which is basically why it rules. It is a breezy adventure with grown-up melancholy tucked inside all the flying and charm.

portrait-of-a-lady-on-fire.good_pick_if: You want a romantic drama that is patient, intimate, and visually exact.
portrait-of-a-lady-on-fire.maybe_skip_if: You want faster pacing or a romance that is less restrained and contemplative.
portrait-of-a-lady-on-fire.summary: People call it "beautifully hypnotic," and that is the room vibe to expect. It is slow, sensual, and built almost entirely out of glances, tension, and precise visual feeling.

possession.good_pick_if: you want something intense, strange, and impossible to sit with passively
possession.maybe_skip_if: you want straightforward horror or a calm movie night
possession.summary: People keep calling it "unrelenting" and "deranged" because it is a feral marital nightmare that never really settles down.

pride-2014.good_pick_if: You want something heartfelt, funny, and easy to root for as a group.
pride-2014.maybe_skip_if: You want a cooler, more detached, or less openly emotional watch.
pride-2014.summary: People say it "makes you feel so much," and that is the right expectation. It is a warm ensemble story about solidarity, joy, and the emotional charge of people showing up for each other in a big way.

primal-fear.good_pick_if: You want a slick legal thriller with strong performances and a big conversation starter.
primal-fear.maybe_skip_if: You want something subtle, procedural, or less interested in a crowd-pleasing reveal.
primal-fear.summary: The hook is the "alchemy in the tension" of a courtroom story that keeps turning the screws without losing momentum.

princess-mononoke.good_pick_if: you want epic fantasy that still gives the room something to chew on
princess-mononoke.maybe_skip_if: you want a lighter or simpler animated adventure
princess-mononoke.summary: People call it "gorgeous and morally complicated" and "big fantasy with real bite." You get the sweep and spectacle, but the messy human tension is what makes it feel so alive.

prisoners.good_pick_if: you want a punishing, high-stakes thriller that keeps tightening the screws
prisoners.maybe_skip_if: you want anything remotely light or emotionally comfortable
prisoners.summary: People call it "heavy as hell" and "impossibly tense," which is pretty much the pitch. It is dark, rainy, and emotionally bruising in a way that can really take over the room, so it works best when everyone is up for a serious thriller with zero interest in being easy.

project-hail-mary.good_pick_if: you want upbeat sci-fi with brains, humor, and a big crowd-pleasing engine
project-hail-mary.maybe_skip_if: you want your sci-fi moodier, weirder, or less talky
project-hail-mary.summary: People talk about its "science-nerd wish fulfillment" vibe because it turns big problem-solving into something warm, funny, and easy to root for.

psycho.good_pick_if: you want a classic thriller that is brisk, stylish, and still a little mean
psycho.maybe_skip_if: you want something gentler or you bounce off older studio-era pacing
psycho.summary: People still call it "sharp as a knife" and "ridiculously fun to watch," which helps explain why it keeps working.
